_readme: Deterministic notice drafts (Drafter agent). An optional LLM may only rephrase a draft; app/agents/drafter.py then checks that every {slot} value still appears verbatim, that no class word other than the from/to classes appears, and that no forbidden phrase (UI.md copy rules) appears. Failing drafts fall back to these templates.
Drafts are for a named genetic counsellor to edit and approve. They are not medical advice and never name the source relative.

UPGRADE.title: Update to your genetic test result ({gene})
UPGRADE.body:
Dear {person_first_name},

The laboratory that analysed your genetic test has updated how it classifies the {gene} variant in your report ({variant}). It was previously reported as {from_class_words}; it is now classified as {to_class_words} (ClinVar release {release}).

{owner_name} and the {service_name} team would like to talk with you about what this update means for you and your care. Please contact us to arrange a conversation.

This letter is not a diagnosis. Please do not change any treatment before speaking with your care team.

NEW_RISK_DIRECT.title: An invitation to talk with the {service_name} team
NEW_RISK_DIRECT.body:
Dear {person_first_name},

A genetic finding in your family may be relevant to your health. The {service_name} team would like to offer you a confidential conversation and, if you wish, a genetic test.

You are under no obligation. If you prefer not to receive further information, tell us and we will respect that.

This letter is not a diagnosis.

NEW_RISK_LETTER.title: Family letter: information you may wish to share
NEW_RISK_LETTER.body:
This letter is for you to share with relatives if you choose to.

A genetic variant in the {gene} gene has been found in our family. Relatives can ask their own doctor or a genetics service about a confidential conversation and testing.

Variant: {variant}. Current classification: {to_class_words} (ClinVar release {release}).

This letter is not a diagnosis.

CORRECTION.title: Correction to earlier information about a genetic variant ({gene})
CORRECTION.body:
Dear {person_first_name},

We wrote to you earlier about the {gene} variant {variant}, which was then classified as {from_class_words}. The laboratory has updated its classification to {to_class_words} (ClinVar release {release}).

This may change the advice you were given. {owner_name} and the {service_name} team would like to talk with you before you make any decision about screening or treatment.

VUS_RESOLVED.title: Update on the uncertain finding in your genetic test ({gene})
VUS_RESOLVED.body:
Dear {person_first_name},

Your genetic test reported a {gene} variant ({variant}) of uncertain significance. The laboratory has updated its classification to {to_class_words} (ClinVar release {release}).

{owner_name} and the {service_name} team would like to talk with you about whether any part of your care plan should be reviewed.

allowed_exception: the word 'diagnosis' is allowed only inside the fixed sentence 'This letter is not a diagnosis.'
